visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man with blonde-dyed hair and extensive arm tattoos leans against a barbell rack in a brightly lit, professional gym. He is wearing a black tank top, and his expression is focused. The camera cuts to a different man in a black 'JOINED' tank top performing heavy barbell bench presses. He exhibits intense physical strain, with facial muscles contorted and mouth open as he pushes the weight. A spotter stands behind him, using hand gestures to assist with the lift. (2) The scene transitions through several close-ups of muscular men training, including one man in a yellow tank top flexing his chest and arm muscles. The background is dense with gym equipment like dumbbells, racks, and plates. The lighting is studio-quality, casting sharp highlights on their muscle definition. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese and a brand logo appear at the top of the frame. The atmosphere shifts from intense training to a more casual, social interaction as characters begin to smile and laugh. (3) A humorous sequence shows four men lined up behind a person performing seated rows, jokingly forming a spotting chain. They are all touching or leaning on each other, creating a comedic visual. This is followed by a group shot where all four muscular men stand together, talking and gesturing towards the camera. One man in a grey sleeveless shirt and a baseball cap is the primary speaker. They all pose and laugh together in the final moments, showing camaraderie in the gym setting.
